notes.title: Update
notes.notes: I double the gem/coin gain from all enemies and mining activities. Hopefully, this is something you wanted and will help lessen the grind. I also added two new buttons on the LEFT menu to disable VSYNC and enable alt timing. Most of you won't need to use these options but are included for those that have high Hz monitors.

notes.title: Linux version released
notes.notes:
The Linux version is live. It has been tested with Ubuntu 16.04, but it should be compatible with any version 12 and above (that is what Steam currently supports). If you have a Linux box check it out and let me know if it works.

DEV NOTE: I spent about 4 hours last night working on uploading the Linux version. It took me that long because I don't really know anything about Linux and I made some stupid mistakes. I pulled out an old laptop and installed Ubuntu 16.04. It seems to work well. I'll do some more testing of course but I the mean time I'll release it to ya'll for more testing.

notes.title: Ready for Retail Release
notes.notes: The story is complete, achievements are set up, trading cards are traded, and we are ready to push to release. Everything is done (except the 4 player arena). Testing next week and squashing bugs and lots of spelling errors.

notes.title: New Update - Space Worms
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26570085/27e34b087c29bcdf85ea8f6bda2819dba5493030.png

A new update is live featuring SPACE WORMS!

You will start seeing smaller worms from level 5-14.

Level 15 has a surprise :)

The worms will split in a piece if broken in the middle. They are also very fast. There are a few weapons that are very effective against them (I'll let you figure that out). The screen will shake and you'll hear a crunching sound when they are close to the player.
